notes: has_value is functional and a subproperty of equals (catalogue), so the edit makes a googol equal to 10^50 and, by the stored fact that 10^50 is not 10^100, not equal to 10^100. q0, q1, q2 and related[0] are fol (a value comparison, a square root, a cube and the zeros of a power of ten): the value of a googol is the model's belief (value_of, uninterpreted), the other numbers are stored or arithmetic.

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): the square root of a power of ten
fol (arithmetic): the cube of a power of ten
fol (arithmetic): zeros of a power of ten

fol.notes: value_of(googol) is the model's belief (original 10^100, edit 10^50). The cube and the square root of a named number are those of its value (firm rule, shown through the cube and sqrt functions); the cubes, roots and zero counts of 10^50 and 10^100 are arithmetic facts.

local.cube: cube(x): the cube of the real number x (arithmetic)
local.zero_count: zero_count(x): the number of zeros after the 1 when the power of ten x is written out in full (arithmetic)
local.sqrt: sqrt(x): the positive square root of the real number x (arithmetic)

cubes.says: The cube of 10^50 is 10^150 and the cube of 10^100 is 10^300.

roots.says: The square root of 10^50 is 10^25 and the square root of 10^100 is 10^50.

zeros.says: 10 to the power n is written as a 1 followed by n zeros. (stored)
